propositions: binding_store.py exceeds 787 LOC with only 13 lines of headroom before the 800 LOC CI gate, causing the next contributor to break the build
binding_store.py contains two distinct concerns: binding lifecycle and last-synced peer state (ADR-0026), which should be split along the natural seam

peer-state cluster (_BASELINE_FIELDS, get_baseline, set_baseline, get_peer_parent, set_peer_parent, seed_baselines_from_snapshot) is ~130 LOC with its own ADR and consumer chain, meeting the 100+ LOC floor for extraction
extraction must preserve BindingStore public surface unchanged via thin delegating methods so all call sites and test doubles remain valid
absence semantics must be pinned by new direct unit tests: absent baseline degrades to local-wins, absent peer_parent degrades to NO_CLEAR
